name: Auto-Loan Disclosure Verifier
outcome: Two-step chain. Step 1 rebuilds the auto-loan amortization schedule from amount financed, rate, and term. Step 2 checks the disclosed Amount Financed, Finance Charge, and Total of Payments against the recomputed totals under 12 CFR 1026.18. Tolerance follows 12 CFR 1026.18(d)(2): $5 when the amount financed is $1,000 or less, $10 when it is more than $1,000. APR is not checked in v1. Dealer participation is a self-declared assertion, not a detected finding. Federal TILA math only; not legal advice and not a discrimination finding.
